seen.body: Owner 2026-10-10: 'time' is a terrible name for the base-35 time string; call the mode base35-time (id_mode, qew migrate-ids --to base35-time, docs, init template). Strict rename, no alias: the owner says no consumer depends on it yet. foundlings' qew-ledger.toml uses id_mode.issue/task = time and must change to base35-time together with the version that carries the rename (minimum_version). Event IDs keep their own description (always time-ordered).
seen.title: Rename the time id mode to base35-time
